# WhatsApp Export Triage

Curated by Skill Harbor — for the unread-pile problem in WhatsApp: it ingests an exported chat (the standard WhatsApp export file, no account connection, no phone access), sorts messages into a triage board, and drafts reply candidates you review before sending anything yourself. The safety design is explicit: it never sends messages automatically, it works from local exports only, and it keeps the whole pipeline on your machine. Discovered via skills.sh, listed here with credit to its creator by @breakthrough-edu. Honest caveats: you must export the chat yourself — it can't read WhatsApp directly, and exports only cover one chat at a time; draft replies are starting points, always re-read before sending; the author's sibling skill with an always-on daemon was deliberately not selected — this one stays local, offline, and on-demand. Skill Harbor never reviews the code, review it yourself before use. Not verified.
